problem.title: Why agency outreach misses the window.
problem.lead: Most firms hear about an open role at the same moment as every competing agency, or risk their reputation on unreviewed automation.

timing.label: Timing
timing.title: Late to the requisition
timing.body: By the time a role reaches the job boards, internal teams have often briefed their preferred suppliers. Two weeks late is too late.

manual.label: Manual work
manual.title: Hours lost to tabs
manual.body: Billers cross-check career pages, announcements and LinkedIn by hand, then write every opening message from scratch.

risk.label: Reputation
risk.title: Risky autopilot sequencers
risk.body: Generic tools blast unreviewed messages and duplicate pitches from the same firm, and the agency's name pays for it.

safety.title: Built for firms that protect their reputation.
safety.lead: ScanAxe is not an autopilot. Every layer is designed around consultant oversight and outreach rules.

approval.title: Human approval, always
approval.body: There is no auto-send switch. Every draft waits in a consultant's queue until it's reviewed and approved.

dedupe.title: No double sends
dedupe.body: A message is never sent twice, never after a reply, and colleagues on different desks don't pitch the same contact.

rules.title: Per-country rules
rules.body: Outreach follows the rules of the recipient's country, and when the country is unknown, the strictest rules apply.

faq.title: Clear answers on signals, control and compliance.

auto.q: Does ScanAxe ever send messages without approval?
auto.a: No. Every signal and draft goes to your review queue, and a person has to approve it before anything is sent.

dedupe.q: How do you stop two of our consultants pitching the same company?
dedupe.a: When a contact is approved for outreach, it's claimed across your workspace for a cooldown period you control, so colleagues don't double-pitch.

data.q: Where do the hiring signals come from?
data.a: From public job postings on company career pages and job platforms, plus public company information. Every card shows the evidence and when it was found. We don't scrape LinkedIn.

linkedin.q: Is my LinkedIn account at risk?
linkedin.a: ScanAxe only works with your own accounts, within conservative daily limits, and you can always send manually. We don't use shared, fake or rented accounts.

compliance.a: Each contact is matched to a country profile that decides what's allowed, when, and with what opt-out wording. Unknown country means the strictest profile. Our rules are being reviewed by legal counsel before launch.

lists.q: Can we upload our client and off-limits lists?
lists.a: Yes. Upload clients, off-limits companies and do-not-contact lists so they never reach a consultant's queue.

language.a: English and Arabic, including right-to-left layouts. Drafts can be written in the language of the recipient.
